Browse & buy PAXG options (USDC linear) days Deribit venue data → Trading days 389 Coverage December 2024 – December 2025 Archive size 228 GB Price per day €1 Activity & identifier PAXG options (USDC linear) on Deribit — activity Per-day trade and turnover statistics are not published for this option chain yet; file counts and sizes below are complete. Since 2026-08-20 5.9K trades · $5.4M Record day $859.0K · 2026-08-20 Files on latest day 276 Typical files / day 516 What's in a bundle One purchase, the whole option chain for a day An option-chain day bundle contains every PAXG options (USDC linear) contract — all strikes and expiries, calls and puts — that was listed on Deribit on that UTC day (276 contract files on the latest covered day). Each file carries the full raw feed: every trade print, Level-2 order-book updates and the venue's mark-price stream with implied volatility and greeks, plus the index price, in the same zstd-compressed schema as our spot and perpetual data. Days above 4 GB ship as one resumable tar. Coverage runs December 2024 – December 2025 — 389 trading days, 228 GB compressed in total. A day typically holds 516 contract files (up to 860 on the busiest day, 1.12 GB). Pick individual days in the shop calendar for €1 each; delivery is an instant per-file download or one archive for the whole day. Month by month PAXG options (USDC linear) — development since capture 5,862 trades and $5.4M of USD turnover over 11 captured days since 2026-08-20 — record day 2026-08-20 with $859.0K. Days = captured UTC days; a partial month shows no month-over-month change. Contracts traded and L2 (order-book) updates exist for days captured with the extended statistics. We record everything The complete public feed of each venue as it was published: every Level-2 snapshot and update, every trade with its aggressor side, every quote, funding, mark-price and liquidation event — for every instrument the venue lists, every UTC day since we added the venue. Where a venue offers more than one order-book feed, we take the one with the lowest latency, at the depth that feed carries. Nothing sampled, no on-demand capture. Institutional grade Captured co-located at the venue with the exchange timestamp and our receive timestamp in integer nanoseconds, an event-id chain that makes any gap visible, and one normalized schema across 35+ venues — the same capture our own high-frequency trading engine and enterprise feeds run on. €1 per instrument-day Any instrument-day is €1, series-day bundles start at €1 — no subscription, no minimum order, no tiers to unlock. Credit packs lower the effective price and never expire, and free full-day samples from the major venues let you test first. Self-service for everyone Pick the days in the Data Shop , pay by card as a guest and download immediately — no sales call, no enterprise contract, no KYC. Coding agents buy the same files through the MCP server , and the free Agent Skill teaches them the format. Agents: /llms.txt · MCP server /mcp · every page as markdown via Accept: text/markdown FAQ Deribit PAXG options (USDC linear) data — FAQ What Deribit PAXG options (USDC linear) data can I download? Every call and put of the chain — all strikes and expiries — for one UTC day (276 contract files on the latest day): tick-by-tick trades, Level-2 order-book updates and the venue's mark-price stream with implied volatility and greeks (delta, gamma, vega, theta). How far back does the PAXG options (USDC linear) data go? Coverage runs December 2024 – December 2025 — 389 trading days in total. How is a PAXG options (USDC linear) day delivered? Per contract file, or as one archive for the day. Days above 4 GB compressed ship as a resumable tar stream instead of a ZIP. Can I get Deribit PAXG options (USDC linear) data as CSV or Parquet? Yes — every free sample and every purchased tick day also exports as gzipped CSV or Parquet at no extra cost: trades in both formats, plus top-of-book (BBO) quotes as CSV. Timestamps are integer microseconds UTC and the columns load straight into pandas, polars or DuckDB — see the formats overview . How much does Deribit PAXG options (USDC linear) historical data cost? €1 per option-chain day bundle — the whole chain for that day — no subscription, no minimum order; buy as a guest in the Data Shop and download immediately. Credit packs lower the effective price and never expire. Do I need an account or a sales call? No. Pick the PAXG options (USDC linear) chain-days in the Data Shop , pay by card as a guest and download immediately — no subscription, no minimum order, no KYC, no enterprise contract, no sales call. Coding agents buy the same bundles through the MCP server . How is the Deribit PAXG options (USDC linear) data captured? Co-located at the venue, message by message: every Level-2 update and every trade print carries the exchange timestamp and our receive timestamp in integer nanoseconds, an event-id chain makes any gap visible, and one normalized schema across 35+ venues means a parser written for Binance reads these files unchanged. It is the same capture our own high-frequency trading engine runs on — nothing sampled. What was the busiest PAXG options (USDC linear) trading day on Deribit? 2026-08-20, with $859.0K of USD premium turnover over 443 trades across every PAXG options (USDC linear) contract of the day; the busiest full month was Aug 2026 at $5.4M. Since our statistics began on 2026-08-20 the option chain has recorded 5,862 trades and $5.4M over 11 captured days. Any of these days is a downloadable bundle.
